fields.summary: The shipit work plan for task 7: the read commands show, tree, ls, why, log, roadmap and ready, each with --view and --json, served from the index. Decided (D1-D17, agent wording accepted by the owner): scope is the seven reads, with ls paged and find, change diff, events and paging elsewhere out; reads use the index only, with new queries where needed, and writes stay untouched; shared read plumbing in internal/api/read.go; why walks decided-by (including inherited from tree ancestors), derived-from and supersedes both ways, shows answered questions, then the change sets in the node's history, cycle-guarded; log lists the view's history of a node or link in apply order; a change set's links for roadmap and ready are the to-be links plus the link operations inside that change set; ready means accepted, every depends-on landed, and no open question blocking the change set, a node it touches or an ancestor, and it names the first ready one as next; roadmap groups proposed and accepted change sets by served intent in intent-tree order, then depends-on order, ties by ID, with a final no-intent group; tree, ls and show shapes; tests with each task; guardrails; finish at an open PR with green CI. Revised by the orchestrator under the owner's authorization: the default view (D2) became one rule shared with slice (draft or proposed change set gives what-if, accepted gives to-be, otherwise as-is), with roadmap and ready always defaulting to to-be (D17); and the read budget (D14) went from a 25 ms median to 50 ms, the milestone target, after CI measured about 25.5 ms, the 25 ms figures staying as benchmarks. Left open: speeding up roadmap and ready, and cursor paging on log, roadmap and why.
fields.title: Shipit plan, milestone 1 task 7: the reads
